description: Performance budget. Original baseline from the Phase 4 verified build (2026-08-25); revised 2026-11-25 to separate eagerly-loaded JS (what the browser must download before the page is interactive) from lazily-loaded chunks (fetched on demand and irrelevant to LCP). Enforced in CI. Raise a threshold only after a measured, justified change — never to mask a regression.

baseline.initialJsNote: Sum of every script/style tag present in dist/index.html. Measured when the total-js / initial-js split was introduced.

budget.description: Eagerly-loaded JS: everything referenced by dist/index.html. Baseline 620.9 KB + 13% margin. This is the LCP-relevant gate and must stay strict; a 3D engine loaded on demand never counts here.

All JS emitted to dist/assets, lazy chunks included. Raised from 790000 (2026-11-25) to admit the NARA 3D runtime (~797 KB measured), which loads only after the page is interactive. Every emitted chunk is still counted; nothing is hidden from this gate.
Total CSS shipped. Baseline 85 KB + 12% margin (~10 KB).

Largest single JS chunk. Raised from 420000 (2026-11-25): the NARA 3D chunk legitimately carries the Three.js runtime (~797 KB) but is fetched only when the character is revealed. The eager entry chunk remains governed by initial-js.
Largest CSS chunk. Baseline 85 KB + 17% margin. Single CSS file is acceptable for the design system scope.
Maximum number of distinct bundles. Raised from 18 (2026-11-25) to admit the NARA 3D engine and model chunks; the headroom above 24 still flags accidental over-splitting.
